_doc: Timed events. icon = index in event_icons.png. effect types: spawn_deposits, geode_mult, ore_bonus, meteor, cart, drop_mult, ancient_chamber, expedition. quest = optional challenge during the event (type/target/count as in quests.json). reward coins scale with the player's deepest biome (x (1 + biome)).

events.name: Crystal Surge
events.desc: More rare crystals are appearing in the deeper mines!

events.name: Geode Fever
events.desc: Geodes are turning up everywhere. Triple geode chance!

events.name: Ore Rush
events.desc: Ore deposits are bursting! Every ore deposit drops +1.

events.name: Meteor Shower
events.desc: Meteorites are crashing into the mountain! Find the fragments in nearby caves.

events.name: Abandoned Mine Cart
events.desc: An old mine cart full of treasure was spotted nearby. Find it before it's gone!

events.name: Double Extraction
events.desc: Lucky streak! All mining drops are doubled.

events.name: Ancient Discovery
events.desc: A hidden chamber has opened somewhere close by. Follow the glow!

events.name: Rare Expedition
events.desc: A special cave route full of rare ore has opened nearby!

quest.text: Mine 8 deposits in the expedition route
